findings.label: Model path assumption
findings.description: Acceptance tests assume ml/models/account_health_lgb.pkl exists relative to project root. Multiple fallback strategies mitigate this but don't guarantee the model is in the right place for CI/production environments. Verify model location matches deployment setup.

findings.label: SHAP optional but untested without it
findings.description: Health scorer SHAP integration skips tests when the library is absent. This is safe but means model environments without SHAP never validate that explainability paths work, leaving integration gaps possible.
